children: Hurco reported third quarter fiscal 2026 net income of $2.3 million, or $0.35 per diluted share, versus a net loss of $3.7 million a year earlier. Third-quarter sales and service fees were $47.289 million, up 3% year-over-year, and gross profit expanded to $13.183 million (28% margin). For the first nine months, Hurco reported a net loss of $3.526 million on $137.775 million of sales, with orders and gross margin improving versus the prior year.
Revenue (Sales and service fees) — Q3 FY2026: $47,289,000; Q3 FY2025: $45,806,000 (3% increase).
Gross profit — Q3 FY2026: $13,183,000 (28% of sales); Q3 FY2025: $9,112,000 (20% of sales).
Diluted earnings per share — Q3 FY2026: $0.35; Q3 FY2025: $(0.58).
Order momentum — Q3 orders were $51.368 million, up 25% year-over-year; nine-month orders were $154.995 million, up 24% year-over-year, with increases across Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Regional performance — Americas sales rose 11% in Q3 driven by higher shipments of 5-axis and larger vertical mills and Takumi/Milltronics lathes; Asia Pacific sales jumped 51% in Q3 driven by increased Hurco and Takumi machine shipments and private-labeled frames.
Europe dynamics — European sales declined year-over-year (12% in Q3) due to lower shipments from the Italy subsidiary (LCM), though European orders increased modestly.

Product mix and margins — Management cites higher mix of 5-axis and higher-performance machines, improved fixed-overhead absorption, and pricing actions as primary contributors to gross margin expansion.
Balance sheet and liquidity — Cash and cash equivalents of $52.087 million and working capital of $166.717 million at July 31, 2026; the company reports no debt.

title: Hurco reports $47.3M revenue and $2.3M net income in Q3 FY2026
